Required fields we need to create a vendor master record:
- Legal name (as on W-9 or incorporation docs)
- Entity type (LLC / Corp / Partnership)
- Tax ID / EIN (if US entity)
- Primary remit address (street, city, state, postal code, country)
- AP contact name, email, phone
- Invoice acceptance method (email portal / EDI / vendor portal / email to AP inbox)
- Bank details only if you want ACH enabled (bank name, account type, routing, account last4) — prefer to collect via secure portal
- W-9 (US), VAT reg (EU), or tax equivalent documentation
- Payment terms and preferred PO routing (PO required, PO exempt for certain subscriptions)

What Redwood will provide after setup:
- Vendor ID and ERP mapping
- Default PO route (e.g., PO-to-Workday -> AP queue) and invoice email
- Confirmation of ACH enablement timeline if provided

Quick asks for you today:
1) Confirm legal name exactly as on W-9 / formation docs
2) Share remit address and AP contact
3) Attach W-9 (or equivalent) and the packet you already sent is helpful

If you prefer, we can send a secure upload link for bank/W-9.
